results.title: “Dissatisfaction with Trump” behind Republican rout in US Midterms, says Congressman Shri Thanedar
results.description: By Ayushi Agarwal Describing the Republican losses in the 2026 US midterm elections as a strong message of public discontent with President Donald Trump Indian-American Congressman in the US House of Representatives Shri Thanedar said that the results reflected growing frustration over rising living costs the Iran war tariffs and corruption within the administration

results.title: Just ₹5 lakh for bride in four days: Manorama exposes Malayali-run marriage racket in Hyderabad
results.description: An undercover investigation in Hyderabad has exposed a marriage racket in which Malayali brokers allegedly arrange second marriages by showcasing young women from poor families to prospective grooms for hefty sums.
